additions.summary: [VS-E26] Dynamic Configuration, Loyalty and Metadata Governance
additions.actor: Platform administrator, customer, host and service owner
additions.outcome: Typed domain-owned configuration can evolve without hard-coded business variants or arbitrary runtime scripts.
additions.context: Authorization v2 supplies dynamic role policy. This epic extends the same versioned, maker-checker governance to loyalty tiers, property metadata and booking policy.
businessRules: Each domain service is the only writer and source of truth for its configuration.
Published versions are immutable; corrections use a new version, retirement, or a compensating ledger entry.
Loyalty qualifying points are neither a Finance trust score nor a redeemable wallet.
Runtime rules are typed and allow-listed; no arbitrary expression or script is stored or executed.

dataPartitions: SELF, OWN, ASSIGNED, PARTITION and ALL are enforced by the owning domain using authoritative membership data.
fieldGroups: Summary is default; sensitive booking commercial fields continue to require booking-sensitive:read.

activationBlockers: Docker/Testcontainers migration evidence and live Newman flows are not yet attached.

additions.summary: [VS-E26-S01] Dynamic loyalty tiers and qualifying-point projection
additions.outcome: Admins publish effective loyalty tier thresholds and customers receive a server-computed tier projection.

dataPartitions: Customer reads SELF; administrators use approved ALL/organization policy.
fieldGroups: Qualifying points and tier only; no Finance trust detail or wallet balance.

activationBlockers: Booking-completed replay-safe consumer and Testcontainers/Newman evidence remain required.

additions.summary: [VS-E26-S02] Typed property attribute catalog and generated host form
additions.outcome: Property criteria beyond fixed invariants are published as typed definitions and rendered dynamically for hosts.

dataPartitions: OWN host relationships and admin PARTITION/ALL are verified from Property data.
fieldGroups: PUBLIC, HOST and ADMIN visibility is filtered at the source.

activationBlockers: Full authoring UI, query-plan evidence and live migration tests remain required.

additions.summary: [VS-E26-S03] Versioned booking policy resolution and immutable evidence
additions.outcome: Booking resolves effective policy deterministically and freezes the evaluated policy evidence with each reservation decision.

dataPartitions: Resolution precedence is PROPERTY, BRANCH, ORGANIZATION, then GLOBAL; client input cannot select scope.
fieldGroups: Policy summary is readable separately from commercial booking data.

activationBlockers: Quote/hold/confirm wiring and live Testcontainers/Newman evidence remain required.

additions.summary: [VS-E26-S04] Dynamic configuration workspace, contracts and rollout evidence
additions.outcome: Admin, customer and host surfaces consume validated versioned contracts with repeatable rollout evidence.

dataPartitions: Each UI receives only domain-authorized data; UI state never expands server scope.
fieldGroups: Catalog and checker queue fields are separated from sensitive customer and commercial data.

activationBlockers: Admin Mobile parity, Newman and zero-diff catalog synchronization remain required.

additions.outcome: Administrators see real, permission-governed operational and commercial statistics in Overview and a dedicated Analytics workspace.

dataPartitions: Cross-property analytics requires ALL; narrower partition projections must be introduced explicitly.
fieldGroups: Revenue is aggregated separately by currency and never mixed into an invalid combined total.

activationBlockers: PR CI and live environment smoke evidence remain required.
